name: ElevenLabs
description: Transcribes every video and voices dubs. The recommended transcription service; OpenAI also works.

transcription.name: Transcription
transcription.description: Convert source audio to timestamped text.

text-to-speech.name: Text to speech
text-to-speech.description: Generate speech audio from supplied text.

music-generation.name: Music
music-generation.description: Compose instrumental background music from a written description.

sound-effect-generation.name: Sound effects
sound-effect-generation.description: Create short sound effects from a written description.

settings.label: ElevenLabs API key
settings.description: Used for transcription and speech. Give it the User read permission too, so Arrumo can show your remaining credits. Stored in the system vault; agents can use it through Arrumo but never read it.

settings.label: Voice ID
settings.description: The ElevenLabs voice that narrates videos. Copy a voice ID from your ElevenLabs voice library. Leave empty to use George.

headline.es: Cada palabra, transcrita y con voz
headline.pt: Cada palavra, transcrita e com voz

body.en: ElevenLabs transcribes your footage so the agent can cut on what was said, and voices dubs when you want a video in another language.
body.es: ElevenLabs transcribe tu metraje para que el agente corte según lo que se dice, y pone voz a los doblajes cuando quieras un vídeo en otro idioma.
body.pt: O ElevenLabs transcreve as tuas gravações para que o agente corte pelo que foi dito, e dá voz às dobragens quando quiseres um vídeo noutra língua.

iconNotice: ElevenLabs and its logo are trademarks of ElevenLabs.
